name: How often should a water heater pressure relief valve be replaced?

mainEntity.name: How often should a water heater pressure relief valve be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: There isn't a universally fixed schedule, but most manufacturers recommend inspecting your water heater's pressure relief valve annually and replacing it every 3 to 5 years, or immediately if it shows signs of leakage or failure. During annual maintenance, a plumber can test the valve to ensure it opens and closes correctly. If the valve leaks or drips constantly, it’s a clear sign it needs replacement. Neglecting replacement can compromise your system's safety, potentially leading to more severe issues down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Water heater pressure relief valves should be inspected annually and typically replaced every 3 to 5 years, or sooner if leaking or failing.
